source.title: Official Sword/Shield Galar Region Strategy Guide
source.edition: launch-era printed guide; interpreted for base Shield 1.3.2
source.citation: printed pages and visible/hidden item sections on each row
source.method: Read visible/hidden item lists, including OCR Visit Items in Stow-on-Side, nested Route 9/Rose Tower sections and the Route 1 table. Exclude the Sword-only Route 6 fossil row. Preserve duplicate printed placements; grouped pearls, Revives, powders and feather pools may share one activity key. Wild Area printed subarea mistakes use the existing native placement audit. This inventories readable pickup lists, not every map pin, gift, shop stock or encyclopedia row. Independently recount the 56 printed p. 28 side-event rows in 15 location groups and resolve the historical per-location key crosswalk, preserving multi-area/multi-step keys.
